revision.text: -- Module:Main page -- Draws the front page from the settings in Module:Main page/config.json. -- The Main Page itself only contains: {{#invoke:Main page|render}} -- To change what's on the front page, edit the settings, not this module. local p = {} local CONFIG_PAGE = 'Module:Main page/config.json' local STYLES = 'Template:Main page/styles.css' local PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE = 'Image unavailable.png' -- same as the infoboxes -- =================================================================== -- Helpers -- =================================================================== local lang = mw.language.getContentLanguage() -- Settings come from mw.loadJsonData, whose lists don't support # (length): -- count them with ipairs instead. local function count(list) local n = 0 if list then for _ in ipairs(list) do n = n + 1 end end return n end local function fileExists(name) if not name or name == '' then return false end local t = mw.title.new(name, 'File') return t ~= nil and t.file ~= nil and t.file.exists end local function cleanFile(name) return name and mw.text.trim((name:gsub('^[Ff]ile:', ''):gsub('^[Ii]mage:', ''))) or nil end -- Remove {{templates}}, even nested ones. local function stripTemplates(s) local out, depth, i = {}, 0, 1 while i <= #s do local two = s:sub(i, i + 1) if two == '{{' then depth = depth + 1; i = i + 2 elseif two == '}}' and depth > 0 then depth = depth - 1; i = i + 2 else if depth == 0 then table.insert(out, s:sub(i, i)) end i = i + 1 end end return table.concat(out) end -- The first paragraph of an article as plain text, cut to about `max` characters. local function excerpt(content, max) local s = stripTemplates(content) s = s:gsub('', '') s = s:gsub(']-/>', ''):gsub('', '') s = s:gsub('%[%[[Ff]ile:[^%]]-%]%]', ''):gsub('%[%[[Ii]mage:[^%]]-%]%]', ''):gsub('%[%[[Cc]ategory:[^%]]-%]%]', '') s = s:gsub('<[^>]->', '') for para in (s .. '\n\n'):gmatch('(.-)\n%s*\n') do local text = mw.text.trim(para) if text ~= '' and not text:match('^=') and not text:match('^[{|!]') and not text:match('^__') then text = text:gsub('%[%[[^%]|]-|([^%]]-)%]%]', '%1'):gsub('%[%[([^%]]-)%]%]', '%1') text = text:gsub('%[https?://%S+%s+([^%]]-)%]', '%1'):gsub("'''?", ''):gsub('%s+', ' ') text = mw.text.trim(text) if mw.ustring.len(text) > max then text = mw.ustring.sub(text, 1, max):gsub('%s+%S*$', '') .. '…' end return text end end return nil end -- The picture from an article's infobox ("| image = …"). local function infoboxImage(content) local name = content:match('|%s*image%s*=%s*([^|\n}]+)') name = name and mw.text.trim(name) if name == '' then return nil end return name end local function problem(text) return mw.html.create('div'):addClass('mp-problem'):wikitext('Main page settings: ' .. text) end -- =================================================================== -- Parts of the page -- =================================================================== local function hero(cfg) local box = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('mp-hero') if cfg.background and fileExists(cfg.background) then box:tag('div'):addClass('mp-hero-bg') :wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|1600px|link=|alt=]]', cleanFile(cfg.background))) end local inner = box:tag('div'):addClass('mp-hero-inner') if cfg.stats ~= false then local stats = inner:tag('div'):addClass('mp-stats') for _, s in ipairs({ { mw.site.stats.articles, 'articles' }, { mw.site.stats.files, 'files' }, { mw.site.stats.users, 'members' }, { mw.site.stats.edits, 'edits' }, }) do local item = stats:tag('span'):addClass('mp-stat') item:tag('b'):wikitext(lang:formatNum(s[1])) item:wikitext(' ' .. s[2]) end end local logo = cleanFile(cfg.logo) if logo and fileExists(logo) then inner:tag('div'):addClass('mp-logo'):wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|180px|link=|alt=%s]]', logo, cfg.title or '')) end if cfg.title then inner:tag('div'):addClass('mp-title'):wikitext(cfg.title) end if cfg.subtitle then inner:tag('div'):addClass('mp-subtitle'):wikitext(cfg.subtitle) end -- Clicking this opens Citizen's own search popup. local search = cfg.search or {} if search.show ~= false then local bar = inner:tag('div') :addClass('mp-search'):addClass('citizen-search-trigger') :attr('role', 'button'):attr('tabindex', '0') bar:tag('span'):addClass('mp-search-icon') bar:tag('span'):addClass('mp-search-text'):wikitext(search.text or 'Search the wiki') if search.shortcutHint ~= false then bar:tag('span'):addClass('mp-search-hint'):wikitext('Press /') end -- Quick searches under the bar, e.g. "Characters" → search prefilled with that word. if count(search.suggestions) > 0 then local chips = inner:tag('div'):addClass('mp-chips') for _, s in ipairs(search.suggestions) do chips:tag('span'):addClass('mp-chip'):addClass('citizen-search-trigger') :attr('role', 'button'):attr('tabindex', '0') :attr('data-citizen-search-prefill', s.prefill or s.label) :wikitext(s.label) end end end return box end local function directories(cfg) if count(cfg.directories) == 0 then return nil end local row = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('mp-directories') for _, d in ipairs(cfg.directories) do local link = d.link or (d.category and (':Category:' .. d.category)) or d.label if link:match('^[Cc]ategory:') then link = ':' .. link end local item = row:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir') if d.image and fileExists(d.image) then item:addClass('mp-dir--image') item:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-bg'):wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|600px|link=|alt=]]', cleanFile(d.image))) end local text = item:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-text') text:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-label'):wikitext(string.format('[[%s|%s]]', link, d.label)) if d.category and d.showCount ~= false then local n = mw.site.stats.pagesInCategory(d.category, 'pages') text:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-count'):wikitext(lang:formatNum(n) .. (n == 1 and ' page' or ' pages')) elseif d.description then text:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-count'):wikitext(d.description) end if d.icon and fileExists(d.icon) then item:tag('div'):addClass('mp-dir-icon'):wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|40px|link=|alt=]]', cleanFile(d.icon))) end end return row end local function card(title, cls) local c = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('mp-card') if cls then c:addClass(cls) end if title then c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-card-title'):wikitext(title) end return c end -- =================================================================== -- Cards: each has a "type" in the settings -- =================================================================== local CARDS = {} -- Today's featured article: one page, or a list that changes every day. CARDS.featured = function (frame, f) local n = count(f.pages) if n == 0 then -- Nothing chosen yet: keep the space, and say how to fill it. local c = card(nil, 'mp-featured') local body = c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-body') body:tag('div'):addClass('mp-kicker'):wikitext(f.label or 'Featured') body:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-text'):wikitext(f.emptyText or 'No featured article yet. Add page names to "pages" in [[Module:Main page/config.json]].') return c end local day = math.floor(os.time() / 86400) local pick = f.pages[(day % n) + 1] if type(pick) == 'string' then pick = { page = pick } end local title = mw.title.new(pick.page or '') if not title or not title.exists then return problem(string.format('the featured page “%s” doesn’t exist.', tostring(pick.page))) end local content = title:getContent() or '' local image = cleanFile(pick.image) or cleanFile(infoboxImage(content)) if not fileExists(image) then image = fileExists(PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE) and PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE or nil end local text = pick.text or excerpt(content, f.excerptLength or 220) local c = card(nil, 'mp-featured') if image then local fig = c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-image') fig:wikitext(string.format('[[File:%s|700px|link=%s|alt=%s]]', image, title.fullText, title.text)) -- Kicker and title over the bottom of the picture local over = fig:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-over') over:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-kicker'):wikitext(f.label or 'Featured') over:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-title'):wikitext(string.format('[[%s|%s]]', title.fullText, pick.label or title.text)) end local body = c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-body') if not image then body:tag('div'):addClass('mp-kicker'):wikitext(f.label or 'Featured') body:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-title'):wikitext(string.format('[[%s|%s]]', title.fullText, pick.label or title.text)) end if text then body:tag('div'):addClass('mp-featured-text'):wikitext(text) end body:tag('div'):addClass('mp-more'):wikitext(string.format('[[%s|%s]]', title.fullText, f.moreText or 'Read more')) return c end -- "Start editing": a short invitation, a link, and the wiki's numbers. CARDS.startEditing = function (frame, s) local c = card(nil, 'mp-start') local head = c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-card-title'):addClass('mp-start-title') if s.link then head:wikitext(string.format('[[%s|%s]]', s.link, s.title or 'Start editing')) else head:wikitext(s.title or 'Start editing') end if s.text then c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-start-text'):wikitext(s.text) end local stats = s.stats or { 'articles', 'edits' } local labels = { articles = 'Articles', edits = 'Edits', files = 'Files', users = 'Members', activeUsers = 'Active members' } local row = c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-start-stats') for _, key in ipairs(stats) do if labels[key] and mw.site.stats[key] then local stat = row:tag('div'):addClass('mp-start-stat') stat:tag('div'):addClass('mp-start-number'):wikitext(lang:formatNum(mw.site.stats[key])) stat:tag('div'):addClass('mp-start-label'):wikitext(labels[key]) end end return c end -- A column of link buttons: wiki pages ("page") or websites ("url"). -- A link with no address yet shows greyed out, so the list can be filled in later. CARDS.links = function (frame, l) if count(l.links) == 0 then return nil end local c = card(l.title, 'mp-links') local list = c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-link-list') for _, link in ipairs(l.links) do local item = list:tag('div'):addClass('mp-link') if link.page and link.page ~= '' then item:wikitext(string.format('[[%s|%s]]', link.page, link.label or link.page)) elseif link.url and link.url:match('^https?://') then item:addClass('mp-link--external'):wikitext(string.format('[%s %s]', link.url, link.label or link.url)) else item:addClass('mp-link--empty'):attr('title', 'No address set yet'):wikitext(link.label or '') end end return c end CARDS.recentChanges = function (frame, rc) local opts = { 'limit=' .. (rc.limit or 8), 'days=' .. (rc.days or 30) } if rc.hideBots ~= false then table.insert(opts, 'hidebots') end if rc.hideMinor then table.insert(opts, 'hideminor') end if rc.hideLogs ~= false then table.insert(opts, 'hidelog') end if rc.namespace ~= nil then table.insert(opts, 'namespace=' .. rc.namespace) end local c = card(rc.title or 'Recent changes', 'mp-rc') c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-rc-list'):wikitext(frame:preprocess('{{Special:RecentChanges/' .. table.concat(opts, ',') .. '}}')) c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-more'):wikitext('[[Special:RecentChanges|' .. (rc.moreText or 'All recent changes') .. ']]') return c end -- Any wikitext: rules, the latest update, an announcement… CARDS.text = function (frame, t) if not t.text or t.text == '' then return nil end local c = card(t.title, 'mp-text') c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-text-body'):wikitext('\n' .. t.text .. '\n') return c end local function intro(cfg) local i = cfg.intro if not i or not i.text or i.text == '' then return nil end local c = card(i.title, 'mp-intro') c:tag('div'):addClass('mp-intro-text'):wikitext('\n' .. i.text .. '\n') return c end -- =================================================================== function p.render(frame) local ok, cfg = pcall(mw.loadJsonData, CONFIG_PAGE) local out = { frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = STYLES }) } if not ok then table.insert(out, tostring(problem('couldn’t read [[' .. CONFIG_PAGE .. ']]. Check it exists and is valid JSON.'))) return table.concat(out) end local page = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('mp') page:node(hero(cfg)) local dirs = directories(cfg) if dirs then page:node(dirs) end local i = intro(cfg) if i then page:node(i) end -- The cards, in up to three columns as listed in the settings. local columns = page:tag('div'):addClass('mp-columns') for _, col in ipairs(cfg.columns or {}) do local column = columns:tag('div'):addClass('mp-column') for _, c in ipairs(col) do local make = CARDS[c.type or ''] if not make then column:node(problem(string.format('unknown card type “%s”.', tostring(c.type)))) elseif c.show ~= false then local built = make(frame, c) if built then column:node(built) end end end end table.insert(out, tostring(page)) return table.concat(out) end return p

The front page. The '''Main Page''' only contains {{#invoke:Main page|render}}; everything on it is set in '''[[Module:Main page/config.json]]'''. Edit the settings there, not this module. == Settings == {| class="wikitable" ! Setting !! What it does |- | title, subtitle || The welcome line and the line under it. |- | logo || File name of the logo (shown round). Upload it first; until it exists, no logo shows. |- | background || Optional picture behind the top of the page. |- | stats || true shows the article, file, member and edit counts at the top. |- | search.text || The words in the search bar. Clicking it opens the site search. |- | search.suggestions || Small buttons under the search bar. Each opens search with its label (or prefill) typed in. |- | directories || The row of directory buttons. Each has a label and either a category (it links there and shows how many pages it has) or a link to any page. Optional: icon (a small picture on the right), image (a picture filling the whole button, shown as it is; the label sits on its left side, so keep that part plain), description (instead of the count), showCount: false. |- | intro || An optional welcome card across the page: title and text (wikitext, links work). |- | columns || The cards under the intro: up to three columns, each a list of cards from top to bottom. On phones they stack. Each card has a type (below); add "show": false to hide one without deleting it. |} == Card types == {| class="wikitable" ! type !! Settings |- | featured || pages: featured articles; with several, a different one shows each day. Each entry is a page name, or { "page": "…", "image": "…", "text": "…", "label": "…" } to override the picture, the text or the shown title. By default the picture comes from the article's infobox and the text is its first paragraph. Also label, excerptLength, moreText. |- | startEditing || title, text, link (the page the title goes to) and stats: any of articles, edits, files, users, activeUsers. |- | links || title and links: each { "label": "…", "page": "…" } for a wiki page or { "label": "…", "url": "https://…" } for a website. A link with an empty address shows greyed out until you fill it in. |- | recentChanges || limit (how many), days, hideBots, hideMinor, hideLogs (uploads, moves, deletions), namespace (0 = articles only; leave it out for every kind of page), title, moreText. |- | text || title and text (wikitext): rules, the latest update, an announcement. |} Leave a setting out (or empty) to hide that part. Problems, like a featured page that doesn't exist, show as a red note on the front page. To try changes before they go live, preview any page with {{#invoke:Main page|render}} after saving the settings.
